newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: German climber falls to his death in Swiss Alps.
newsitem.headline: German climber falls to his death in Swiss Alps.

text.p: A 47-year-old German climber fell to his death on Monday on the Moench mountain in central Switzerland, at least the 39th climber to die in the Swiss Alps since mid-July.

Berne cantonal police said the man, whom they did not name, was heading toward the 4,099-metre (13,400-foot) Moench peak along the normal climbing route when he plunged some 300 metres (980 feet) to his death. It was not clear why he fell.
A combination of snow, heat and thunderstorms has made high-altitude climbing treacherous during the summer tourist season.
Other climbers witnessed the man's fall. His body was removed from the mountain by helicopter and a local rescue squad.
